title: A zero-image Koszul cochain vanishes at a later exponent
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, r a natural number, f : Fin r → A, and F an integer-indexed complex of sheaves of modules on Spec(A), with every F.X q quasi-coherent. For the specified diagram and cocone [def-sc-koszul-cech-comparison-construction], if a degree-n element z at stage e : ℕ has zero image under the cocone leg transported to its principal alternating Cech target, then some b ≥ e has zero image of z under the diagram transition e → b. No cycle condition is assumed.

source.place: Tags 08D0 and 08D1, localization fraction map and finite total-degree diagonals; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08D0 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08D1.

proof.text:
Transport z through koszulCechHomObjIso and evaluate on the ordered exterior
basis indexed by nonempty subsets J. Put g_J = product of f_j over J. Transport
the zero-image hypothesis through principalCechObjIso. The cocone's formula and
invertibility of its sign imply that every global-section coordinate m_J restricts
to zero on D(g_J). By affine quasi-coherence this restriction is localization at
g_J; the localization zero criterion gives a power g_J^k_J annihilating m_J.
Choose k at least every k_J, possible since there are finitely many nonempty J.
The specified transition from e to b = e+k multiplies the J-coordinate by g_J^k,
so every coordinate at b is zero. The ordered exterior bases detect equality of
the linear cochain components; the other tail terms are zero. Hence the cochain
at b is zero. The diagram's object identifications transport this equality to
its actual map. For r=0 there are no coordinates and z is already zero (b=e);
for r=1 this is the usual localization zero criterion; nilpotent generators and
F=0 require no exception. No assumption that z is a cycle is used. Mathlib tools: Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent and isIso_fromTildeΓ_iff_isLocalizing identify restriction with localization; Module.Basis.exteriorPower on the standard Finsupp basis gives the ordered exterior coordinates. The formula and object transports are provided by the comparison construction; the specified exterior diagonal transition is supplied by the Koszul open system.

lean.statement:
theorem koszulCechCocone_stage_kernel
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    (F : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hF : ∀ n : ℤ, (F.X n).IsQuasicoherent) (n : ℤ) (e : ℕ)
    (z : ((koszulCechHomDiagram A r f
      (((affineOpenSections A ⊤).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj F)).obj
        e).X n)
    (hz : (((koszulCechCocone A r f F).ι.app e ≫
      eqToHom (koszulCechCocone_exists A r f F).choose_spec.1).f n) z = 0) :
    ∃ (b : ℕ) (h : e ≤ b),
      (((koszulCechHomDiagram A r f
        (((affineOpenSections A ⊤).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj F)).map
          (homOfLE h)).f n) z = 0
